## Summary

Describe the design or workflow outcome and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] Project files parse and use matching stems.
- [ ] ERC evidence is current.
- [ ] DRC evidence is current.
- [ ] Connectivity, polarity, footprints, placement, routing, and silkscreen were reviewed as applicable.
- [ ] Final renders were inspected.
- [ ] No lock, cache, router exchange, secret, or personal path is included.
- [ ] Remaining warnings and human-review requirements are documented.
